metadata.name: After Hours
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: Co-op night at the museum. You and two guard bots do the rounds while the exhibits wake one gallery at a time: imps out of the Egyptian sarcophagi in the Hall of Antiquities, puglins bursting out of the suits of armour, zombies from behind the weeping angels as the Gothic gallery's candles gutter, and oculi and cyclopes loose from the Space Hall's cryo pods. Then take the curator's key, start the tank in the Military wing and blast through the wall into the Grand Atrium for the Scolitex. A Skyfighter on a plinth in the atrium flies out through the skylight.

objectives.text: Do your rounds: clear all four galleries
Take the Military wing key from the curator's office
Break through into the atrium with the tank

do.text: Night shift at the museum. Do your rounds: the Antiquities, the Armour Gallery, Gothic and the Space Hall.
The armour was hollow... and full of puglins!
The front doors won't open. The tank in the Military wing is the only way out: the curator keeps the key upstairs.
Military wing open. Start the tank and blast through the wall into the atrium!
Shell the reinforced wall (explosives only) to break into the atrium.
Something huge is moving in the atrium... THE SCOLITEX!
Something huge is moving in the atrium... THE SCOLITEX!
Something huge is moving in the atrium... THE SCOLITEX!
The sun is coming up. The exhibits are still. Shift over.
The night shift is over for good.
